owner_description:
Detail Guys Dubai is a premium automotive detailing and paint protection specialist in Dubai, dedicated to keeping your vehicle looking brand new. We offer high-quality Paint Protection Film (PPF), Ceramic Coating, Window Tinting, Color PPF, Car Wrapping, Paint Correction, Interior Detailing, Exterior Detailing, Headlight Protection, and premium car care services.

Our experienced team uses advanced techniques and high-quality materials to deliver exceptional results with long-lasting protection and a flawless finish. Whether you own a luxury, sports, electric, or everyday vehicle, we provide customized solutions to protect your investment.

reviews.author: Awadh Symphony
reviews.text:
I recently purchased a new car and was exploring options for Paint Protection Film (PPF). Like many first-time buyers, I was unsure about what PPF actually was and where I could get it installed without being overcharged.

Fortunately, I came across this company through social media, and I was attended to by Mr. Pradeep. From the very beginning, he impressed me with his professionalism, patience, and depth of knowledge. He took the time to clearly explain the concept, benefits, and long-term value of PPF, much like an experienced relationship manager guiding a valued client.

Rather than pushing a particular product, he presented multiple options and helped me arrive at the most suitable choice based on practical considerations and my specific requirements. He also highlighted the importance of windshield protection, making me aware of potential risks and the benefits of safeguarding it against future damage.

The entire process was handled with remarkable efficiency and professionalism. The work was completed within the promised timeframe, and the quality of execution met my expectations.

I was asked to return after ten days for a minor correction related to the PPF installation. During this follow-up visit, Mr. Pradeep was equally courteous, supportive, and attentive. He ensured that everything was addressed smoothly and completed within the stipulated time.

Overall, I am thoroughly impressed with the level of service I received. Mr. Pradeep managed every aspect of my PPF requirements with exceptional professionalism, dedication, and customer focus. His expertise, honesty, and commitment to customer satisfaction made the entire experience seamless and reassuring. I would gladly recommend him and the company to anyone looking for reliable and high-quality PPF solutions.

reviews.author: Calvin Caines
reviews.text:
I’m extremely disappointed with the service, communication, and overall customer experience.

I recently had PPF work done on my car by Detail Guys. Before the work started, I visited the garage in person and clearly explained everything I wanted done. After dropping off my car, I also sent a detailed WhatsApp message confirming our discussion to avoid any misunderstandings.

They kept my car for approximately 10 days. When I went to collect it, I noticed that the headlight tint I previously had was removed and not reinstalled. I immediately raised this with their staff and was told it would be taken care of when I brought the car back for corrections.

After dropping the car off a second time for corrections, I went back to collect it and found that the headlight tint still had not been put back on. When I asked why, I was told they didn’t have the tint — something I was never informed of beforehand. Communication from their end was absolutely non-existent throughout this process.

I was then asked to bring the car back a third time. I declined and requested that they send someone to my location instead, as I had already returned twice. They agreed and scheduled a visit at 8:30 pm. I specifically asked whether visibility at that time would be sufficient to properly address the corrections and was assured it would be.

However, after about 10 minutes on-site, I received a message stating they were finished. When I asked if the requested corrections were completed, I was told they were not.

Their communication was extremely poor. I had to follow up numerous times, was repeatedly told someone would get back to me, and was given dates and times that were never honored. I was constantly chasing them instead of receiving proactive updates or solutions.

Overall, the lack of accountability, poor communication, and repeated failure to complete agreed work make this a service I cannot recommend. I would strongly advise others to look elsewhere for PPF or car detailing services.
